images.author: Albert Lackner, mit genehmigtem Upload von User Origami-Kranich
images.caption: A panorama of the "Rennfeld" in Styria, Austria. The peak is 1629 meters, directly beside the Ottokar-Kernstock-Schutzhaus. At good viewing conditions, you can see Bruck an der Mur in the valley and the wide panorama of the mountain landscape.
